steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the required project title.
Configure the project with RFQ only, as required by the case.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Open the project-level terms and conditions flow.

args.goal: add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", and click Done; stop when the terms are saved

steps.note: Configure both project-level clauses and mark them mandatory.
Add the available QA vendor to the RFQ participants.
Commit the 30-minute schedule starting now.
Publish the configured RFQ project.
Confirm the project was published successfully.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Verify the first project-level mandatory clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second project-level mandatory clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to quote 100 and submit; submission must be blocked because the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
